title: Half Chicken with Grilled Vegetables and Patata Harra

ingredientSections.heading: Chicken Marinade
items: 2 small whole chickens, halved, or 1 large chicken, quartered

methodSections.heading: Chicken Marinade (the day before)
steps: De-seed, roughly chop and then blend the red peppers in a blender.
Slowly simmer in a pan for around 15 minutes, stirring occasionally to avoid sticking, or until most of the liquid has evaporated.
Allow to cool then return to the blender along with the remaining chicken marinade ingredients and blend until smooth.
Marinade the chicken in the mixture overnight.

methodSections.heading: Half Chicken with Grilled Vegetables and Patata Harra
steps: Cut the fingerling potatoes in half lengthwise, toss with olive oil and bake at 190°C (400°F) for 30-40 minutes or until soft.
While the potatoes are in the oven, cut the zucchinis into 1cm (½in) circles and grill or pan fry with the cherry tomatoes in a splash of olive oil.
Mix the cinnamon, paprika, cumin, parsley, cilantro, garlic, lemon juice and zest, chilis and olive oil in a bowl.

Grill the chicken on a BBQ or in a heavy frying pan on high heat for 5 minutes on each side then finish in the oven at 190°C (400°F) for around 45 minutes or until its internal temperature reaches 85°C (185°F).
When the potatoes are cooked and still hot, toss them with the cooked zucchini and tomatoes in the cinnamon parsley mix and adjust the seasoning if necessary.
